tags: 1-5/8  Black Iron Square Pyramid Door Clavos

text.description_html:
Acorn CLBBP, Forged Iron 1-5/8 Inch Square Pyramid Clavos

Clavos are false nail heads that create a rustic appearance or used as accents on antique looking furniture and doors. These 1-5/8 Inch Black Iron Forged Square Pyramid Clavos are the perfect finishing detail to old world style doors. In the days where hand-forged iron could be found on every door, these would be the head of a massive bolt or nail; but today they are decorative and a lot easier to install. They have a square shaped pyramid head and are good for interior as well as exterior use.

Also Available 3/4" Square Pyramid Clavos and 1" Square Pyramid Clavos

Specifications of the Acorn Black Iron Square Pyramid Door Clavos:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • 1-5/8" Square
  • Easy Installation! Drill a 7/32" pilot hole into each location on the door where you need a clavos. Tap the clavos in. Note: The clavos stem is 1/2" diameter x 1" long.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold Individually
